_readme: Per-hotel cover photo for the Oteller card, keyed by the hotel's KITOB name (as in the KITOB list). {"cover": "<part of a source file name on hotelsofnorthcyprus.com>"} moves that photo to the front of the gallery; {"cover": null} shows no photo (placeholder). Read by scripts/import-hnc-hotels.mjs; a name that matches no hotel stops the import.

Merit Lefkoşa Hotel & Casino.reason: KITOB's page has no photo of the hotel (a museum, an event poster and stock images). Commons CC0 photo (2012), Bedrettin Demirel Avenue: the hotel on the right with the MERIT roof sign; the YAR office tower on the left. Chosen over 'Merit and YAR highrises in North Nicosia 1-3' (CC BY-SA 3.0), where the YAR tower and logo dominate.

Almond Holiday Village.reason: KITOB's first photo is a bathroom; the pool and garden show the hotel.

Dome Hotel.reason: First photo is an interior hallway; this one shows the building.

Riverside Garden Resort.reason: First photo is a breakfast table; the pool area shows the resort.

Rocks Hotel & Casino.reason: First photo is a room; this is the building on the harbour.

Salamis Bay Conti Resort Hotel.reason: First photo is the lobby; this is the hotel and pool from outside.

White Pearl Hotel.reason: First photo is a restaurant terrace with guests; this is the hotel building.

Hamsa Hotel.reason: KITOB's only image is the hotel's logo (with the Tervetuloa restaurant mark), not a photo.
